content: MS Majlis 10196/47 ff. 371b-73b and 375b-82a carries Tuḥfa-yi ʿAlāʾī, undated (Ḥāʾirī, Majlis, 32/243); it is the only copy listed. The gap between the two ranges falls where Melvin-Koushki elsewhere (p.97) reports an interjected fragment of Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī's preface at ff. 374b-75b, which would overlap the resumption at f. 375b.
